> **How this report is produced.** All computation is done by
> `run_meta_mqtl.R` (run it first, ideally on a high-memory node:
> `Rscript run_meta_mqtl.R --cores 16`). This notebook only reads its outputs
> in `results/META_MQTL/{meta,qc}` and draws tables and figures. The split was
> made on 2026-11-14, when the fixed PEG results made the cohort files
> (~40M rows) and the cross-cohort intersection (~1.8M pairs) too large for an
> in-notebook analysis.

# 1. Configuration

```{r config}
META_DIR <- file.path(params$meta_root, "meta")
QC_DIR   <- file.path(params$meta_root, "qc")

META_GROUPS <- list(
  cases    = c("peg1_cases",    "ppmi_cases"),
  controls = c("peg1_controls", "ppmi_controls")
)

DATASET_LABELS <- c(
  peg1_cases    = "PEG1 Cases",
  peg1_controls = "PEG1 Controls",
  peg2_cases    = "PEG2 Cases",
  ppmi_cases    = "PPMI Cases",
  ppmi_controls = "PPMI Controls"
)
DATASET_COLORS <- c(
  peg1_cases    = "#E41A1C",
  peg1_controls = "#377EB8",
  peg2_cases    = "#FF7F00",
  ppmi_cases    = "#4DAF4A",
  ppmi_controls = "#984EA3"
)
GROUP_COLORS <- c(cases = "#E41A1C", controls = "#377EB8")

fmt_n    <- function(x) format(x, big.mark = ",")
fmt_pval <- function(x) case_when(
  is.na(x)   ~ "NA",
  x < 1e-300 ~ "< 1e-300",
  x < 0.001  ~ formatC(x, format = "e", digits = 2),
  TRUE       ~ as.character(round(x, 4)))
```

# 2. Per-Cohort QC

> **Note on Lambda GC:** not reported. MatrixEQTL writes only associations
> passing its cis threshold (p < 1e-2 PEG, 1e-3 PPMI) and the script reads all
> cohorts at a common p < 1e-3, so lambda on this truncated tail would be
> meaningless. The QQ plots below use the true number of cis tests to place
> expected quantiles.

## 2.1 Result Summary

```{r result-summary}
summary_df <- fread(file.path(QC_DIR, "dataset_summary.csv"))

summary_df %>%
  mutate(label = DATASET_LABELS[dataset],
         across(c(n_assoc, n_fdr05, n_p1e5, n_p1e8, n_extreme), fmt_n),
         across(c(median_beta, max_beta), ~ round(.x, 4))) %>%
  select(label, n_assoc, n_fdr05, n_p1e5, n_p1e8, median_beta, max_beta, n_extreme) %>%
  knitr::kable(
    col.names = c("Dataset", "N assoc (p<1e-3)", "FDR<0.05", "p<1e-5", "p<1e-8",
                  "Median |β|", "Max |β|", "N |β|>1"),
    caption = paste("Per-cohort cis-mQTL summary. FDR is MatrixEQTL's per-file FDR over",
                    "all tested cis pairs (valid within cohort). β is per ALT allele",
                    "on the methylation beta-value scale, so |β| > 1 would indicate a",
                    "scaling problem."))

if (any(summary_df$max_beta > 1))
  cat("WARNING: |β| > 1 in", paste(summary_df$dataset[summary_df$max_beta > 1], collapse = ", "),
      "- check methylation scale / covariates.\n")
```

```{r counts-plot, fig.height=4}
summary_df %>%
  select(dataset, n_p1e5, n_p1e8) %>%
  pivot_longer(c(n_p1e5, n_p1e8), names_to = "threshold", values_to = "n") %>%
  mutate(label = DATASET_LABELS[dataset],
         threshold = factor(threshold, c("n_p1e5", "n_p1e8"), c("p < 1e-5", "p < 1e-8"))) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = label, y = n, fill = dataset)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.7) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = DATASET_COLORS, guide = "none") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = comma) +
  facet_wrap(~threshold, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(title = "Significant Associations per Dataset", x = NULL, y = "Count") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1))
```

## 2.2 QQ Plots

Points were computed by the script from all retained p-values and thinned to
one per 0.01 cell on the −log10 scale; expected quantiles and the 95% band use
the true number of cis tests per cohort.

```{r qq-function}
plot_qq <- function(dt, title, color) {
  n <- dt$n[1]; n_total <- dt$n_total[1]
  ggplot(dt, aes(x = exp, y = obs)) +
    geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = ci_lo, ymax = ci_hi), fill = "lightblue", alpha = 0.4) +
    geom_point(size = 0.5, alpha = 0.5, color = color) +
    geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, color = "red", linewidth = 0.7) +
    labs(title = title,
         subtitle = sprintf("n = %s%s", fmt_n(n),
                            if (n_total > n) sprintf(" (of %s cis tests)", fmt_n(n_total)) else ""),
         x = "Expected  –log₁₀(p)", y = "Observed  –log₁₀(p)") +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
    theme(plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 9, color = "grey40"))
}
```

```{r qq-plots, fig.width=14, fig.height=9}
qq <- fread(file.path(QC_DIR, "qq_points.csv.gz"))
wrap_plots(lapply(split(qq, qq$dataset)[names(DATASET_LABELS)], function(d)
  plot_qq(d, DATASET_LABELS[d$dataset[1]], DATASET_COLORS[d$dataset[1]])), ncol = 3) +
  plot_annotation(title = "QQ Plots — Per-Dataset Cis mQTL Analyses",
                  theme = theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 15, face = "bold")))
```

# 3. Meta-Analysis Strategy

**Common-effect (fixed) inverse-variance meta-analysis** (`meta::metagen()`,
or its exact closed form with `--engine closed_form`). Fixed effects suits
cohorts drawn from the same population, where we want one common effect.

- **Effect size:** β from MatrixEQTL (per ALT allele in both pipelines)
- **Standard error:** SE = |β / t|
- **Pairs:** only SNP–CpG pairs present at p < 1e-3 in *all* constituent cohorts
- **Groups:** cases = PEG1 × PPMI; controls = PEG1 × PPMI; sensitivity =
  PEG1 × PEG2 × PPMI cases
- **Heterogeneity:** Cochran's Q and I² (`metagen()` stores I² as a proportion;
  shown here as %)
- **FDR:** Benjamini–Hochberg over meta p-values within each group

```{r load-meta}
meta_results <- lapply(setNames(names(META_GROUPS), names(META_GROUPS)), function(g)
  fread(file.path(META_DIR, paste0(g, "_meta_results.csv.gz")),
        colClasses = list(character = c("pair_id", "snp_id", "cpg_id"))))
sens_file <- file.path(META_DIR, "cases_peg2_sensitivity_meta_results.csv.gz")
sens <- if (file.exists(sens_file)) fread(sens_file, colClasses = list(character = c("pair_id", "snp_id", "cpg_id"))) else NULL
```

---

# 4. Meta-Analysis Results

## 4.1 Summary

```{r meta-summary}
all_groups <- c(meta_results, if (!is.null(sens)) list(cases_peg2_sensitivity = sens))
imap_dfr(all_groups, function(d, g) tibble(
  group     = g,
  n_pairs   = nrow(d),
  pct_fdr05 = round(100 * mean(d$FDR_BH < 0.05), 1),
  n_fdr05   = sum(d$FDR_BH < 0.05),
  n_fdr10   = sum(d$FDR_BH < 0.10),
  n_p1e5    = sum(d$meta_pval < 1e-5),
  n_p1e8    = sum(d$meta_pval < 1e-8),
  n_in_peg2 = if ("in_peg2" %in% names(d)) sum(d$in_peg2 & d$FDR_BH < 0.05) else NA,
  pct_het   = round(100 * mean(d$Q_pval < 0.05), 1))) %>%
  mutate(across(c(n_pairs, n_fdr05, n_fdr10, n_p1e5, n_p1e8, n_in_peg2), fmt_n)) %>%
  knitr::kable(
    col.names = c("Group", "Pairs", "% FDR<0.05", "FDR<0.05", "FDR<0.10",
                  "p<1e-5", "p<1e-8", "FDR<0.05 & in PEG2", "% Q p<0.05"),
    caption = paste("Meta-analysis summary. 'FDR<0.05 & in PEG2' = primary cases hits",
                    "whose pair is also present in PEG2 cases at p < 1e-3."))
```

## 4.3 Top Meta-mQTLs

```{r top-meta-hits, results="asis"}
for (g in names(META_GROUPS)) {
  ds  <- META_GROUPS[[g]]
  top <- fread(file.path(META_DIR, paste0(g, "_top20.csv")))
  cat(sprintf("\n### %s — Top 20\n\n", str_to_title(g)))
  top %>%
    mutate(meta_beta = round(meta_beta, 4), meta_se = round(meta_se, 4),
           meta_pval = fmt_pval(meta_pval), FDR_BH = fmt_pval(FDR_BH),
           I2 = round(100 * I2, 1), Q_pval = fmt_pval(Q_pval),
           across(ends_with("_beta") & !matches("^meta"), ~ round(.x, 4)),
           across(ends_with("_pvalue"), fmt_pval)) %>%
    select(snp_id, cpg_id, meta_beta, meta_se, meta_pval, FDR_BH, I2, Q_pval,
           all_of(paste0(ds, "_beta")), all_of(paste0(ds, "_pvalue"))) %>%
    knitr::kable(col.names = c("SNP", "CpG", "Meta β", "Meta SE", "Meta p", "FDR", "I² (%)", "Q p",
                               paste(DATASET_LABELS[ds], "β"), paste(DATASET_LABELS[ds], "p")),
                 caption = sprintf("Top 20 %s meta-mQTLs with per-study statistics", g)) %>%
    print()
}
```

## 4.4 Cases vs Controls Comparison

For pairs tested in both meta-analyses and FDR < 0.05 in at least one:

```{r cases-vs-controls, fig.height=5}
shared <- merge(
  meta_results$cases[,    .(pair_id, beta_cases = meta_beta, fdr_cases = FDR_BH)],
  meta_results$controls[, .(pair_id, beta_ctrls = meta_beta, fdr_ctrls = FDR_BH)],
  by = "pair_id")
cat(sprintf("Pairs tested in both groups: %s\n", fmt_n(nrow(shared))))

sig_either <- shared[fdr_cases < 0.05 | fdr_ctrls < 0.05][
  , sig_group := fcase(fdr_cases < 0.05 & fdr_ctrls < 0.05, "Both",
                       fdr_cases < 0.05, "Cases only",
                       default = "Controls only")]
cat(sprintf("FDR<0.05 in either group: %s\n", fmt_n(nrow(sig_either))))
print(table(sig_either$sig_group))
cat(sprintf("Sign concordance (Both): %.3f; cor(β): %.3f\n",
            sig_either[sig_group == "Both", mean(sign(beta_cases) == sign(beta_ctrls))],
            sig_either[sig_group == "Both", cor(beta_cases, beta_ctrls)]))

# thin plotted points only (one per 0.002 β cell per group)
sig_plot <- sig_either[!duplicated(data.table(round(beta_cases / 0.002), round(beta_ctrls / 0.002), sig_group))]
ggplot(sig_plot, aes(x = beta_cases, y = beta_ctrls, color = sig_group)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.5, size = 1) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey40") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "grey70") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, color = "grey70") +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Both" = "#4DAF4A", "Cases only" = "#E41A1C", "Controls only" = "#377EB8")) +
  labs(title = "Cases vs Controls Meta-mQTL Effect Sizes",
       subtitle = "FDR < 0.05 in at least one group (points thinned for plotting)",
       x = "β (Cases meta-analysis)", y = "β (Controls meta-analysis)", color = NULL) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")
```

## 4.5 Volcano Plots

```{r volcano-plots, fig.width=13, fig.height=5}
sig_colors <- c("FDR<0.05 (positive)" = "#E41A1C", "FDR<0.05 (negative)" = "#377EB8",
                "Not significant" = "grey70")
volcano <- imap(meta_results, function(d, g) {
  fdr_thresh <- d[FDR_BH < 0.05, max(meta_pval)]
  # -log10 p from z: meta p underflows to 0 below ~1e-308
  dp <- d[, .(meta_beta, neg_log10_p = -(pnorm(-abs(meta_z), log.p = TRUE) + log(2)) / log(10),
              sig = fcase(FDR_BH < 0.05 & meta_beta > 0, "FDR<0.05 (positive)",
                          FDR_BH < 0.05 & meta_beta < 0, "FDR<0.05 (negative)",
                          default = "Not significant"))]
  counts <- table(factor(dp$sig, names(sig_colors)))
  # thin plotted points only; counts above use all pairs
  dp <- dp[!duplicated(data.table(round(meta_beta / 0.002), round(neg_log10_p / 0.02), sig))]
  ggplot(dp, aes(x = meta_beta, y = neg_log10_p, color = sig)) +
    geom_point(size = 0.7, alpha = 0.5) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(fdr_thresh), linetype = "dashed", color = "grey30", linewidth = 0.5) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey30", linewidth = 0.5) +
    scale_color_manual(values = sig_colors) +
    annotate("text", x = Inf, y = -log10(fdr_thresh), label = "FDR=0.05",
             hjust = 1.1, vjust = -0.5, size = 3, color = "grey30") +
    annotate("text", x = Inf, y = Inf,
             label = sprintf("FDR<0.05: %s\n(+) %s  (–) %s", fmt_n(sum(counts[1:2])),
                             fmt_n(counts[1]), fmt_n(counts[2])),
             hjust = 1.05, vjust = 1.3, size = 3.2, color = "grey20") +
    labs(title = sprintf("%s Meta-Analysis Volcano Plot", str_to_title(g)),
         subtitle = sprintf("%s total pairs", fmt_n(nrow(d))),
         x = "Meta-analysis β (per ALT allele)", y = "-log₁₀(p)", color = NULL) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom", legend.text = element_text(size = 9))
})
wrap_plots(volcano, ncol = 2) +
  plot_annotation(title = "Volcano Plots — Meta-Analysis Results",
                  theme = theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 15, face = "bold")))
```

## 4.6 Heterogeneity Summary

`metagen()` returns I² as a proportion; it is converted to % here. (The
pre-2026-11-14 notebook compared the proportion against 25/50/75, so its
"I² > 50%" share was always 0.)

```{r heterogeneity}
for (g in names(meta_results)) {
  sig <- meta_results[[g]][FDR_BH < 0.05][, I2_pct := 100 * I2]
  if (nrow(sig) == 0) next
  cat(sprintf("\n%s — heterogeneity among FDR<0.05 hits (n = %s):\n", str_to_title(g), fmt_n(nrow(sig))))
  cat(sprintf("  Median I²:          %.1f%%\n", median(sig$I2_pct)))
  cat(sprintf("  %% with Q p<0.05:    %.1f%%\n", 100 * mean(sig$Q_pval < 0.05)))
  cat(sprintf("  %% with I² > 50%%:    %.1f%%\n", 100 * mean(sig$I2_pct > 50)))
  print(ggplot(sig, aes(x = I2_pct)) +
    geom_histogram(bins = 40, fill = "steelblue", color = "white") +
    geom_vline(xintercept = c(25, 50, 75), linetype = "dashed", color = "firebrick", alpha = 0.6) +
    annotate("text", x = c(25, 50, 75), y = Inf, label = c("Low", "Moderate", "High"),
             vjust = 2, hjust = -0.1, size = 3, color = "firebrick") +
    labs(title = sprintf("%s: I² Distribution (FDR<0.05 hits)", str_to_title(g)),
         x = "I² (%)", y = "Count") +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 12))
}
```
